children: Booz Allen Hamilton's adjusted diluted EPS rose 18.1% year over year to $1.76 in the second quarter, the company says, outpacing a 3.9% revenue decline to $2.8 billion. The earnings gain reflects stronger operational execution and margin expansion, with adjusted Ebitda margin on revenue rising 10 basis points to 11.3%. The company raised its fiscal 2027 adjusted diluted EPS guidance to $6.50-$6.70, above the prior range of $6.00-$6.35. Adjusted net income climbed 15.3% to $211 million while net income rose 3.4% to $181 million
